env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd variants
logos run .
stdout '^0$'
logos run -tags=alpha .
stdout '^21$'
logos run -tags=beta .
stdout '^41$'
logos run -tags=alpha,beta .
stdout '^62$'

# Each inactive file is lowered separately, but the emitted files must
# also compile together. Their filenames differ only in punctuation.
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists feature-a.go
exists feature_a.go
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
stdout '^0$'
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run -tags=alpha .
stdout '^21$'
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run -tags=beta .
stdout '^41$'
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run -tags=alpha,beta .
stdout '^62$'

-- variants/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplevariants

go 1.27

-- variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

var total int

func pair(n int) (int, int) { return n, n + 1 }
func main() { fmt.Println(total) }

-- variants/feature-a.lgo --
//go:build alpha

package main

var a = pair(10)

func init() {
	x, y := a
	total += x + y
}

-- variants/feature_a.lgo --
//go:build beta

package main



var b = pair(20)

func init() {
	x, y := b
	total += x + y
}
